name: Feta & Harissa Egg Smash
notes:
A punchy egg smash with fragrant harissa, salty feta and a squeeze of lemon, with seeds for crunch. Good in a sandwich or on toast.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 9 eggs
• 60g mixed seeds
• 1½ tbsp 5% fat Greek yoghurt
• 2 tbsp mayonnaise
• 3 tbsp harissa paste
• 200g feta
• 1 lemon
• 15g fresh parsley
• Salt
• Black pepper
• 3 slices sourdough

Method:
1. Bring a pan of water to the boil. Lower in the eggs and cook for 8 mins.
2. Cool the eggs in cold water, then peel. If you like, separate the yolks from the whites.
3. Add the eggs to a large bowl with the Greek yoghurt, mayonnaise and harissa. Crumble in the feta, zest in the lemon and squeeze in the juice. Finely chop the parsley and add it. Add the mixed seeds, season, then smash everything together with a pizza cutter.
4. Toast the sourdough, add a dollop of the smash to each slice and serve. Prepped ahead, it keeps in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 days.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 17g, fibre 5g, sugars 7g, sodium 1777mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/high-protein-feta-harissa-egg-smash
